description: Riveted square upstand, pitch pocket and four-sided gravity exhaust hood.
Ribbed prism glass, inclined glazing and a double-seamed galvanised roof curb.
Euro-size stringer pallet, bearing blocks, deck boards and inset nail heads.
Ribbed closed-head galvanised steel drum with rolled chimes and threaded plugs.
Warehouse shelf bays with paint pails, cartons, folded-steel brackets and conduit.
Curved oatmeal upholstery, rolled seams and four tapered walnut legs.
Bird of paradise with broad split leaves, two flowering spathes and a glazed planter.
Steel sales rail with wooden hangers, lined wool and suede jackets, and folded stock.
Riveted dry-freight box, rolled rear door, separately glazed cab and independently spinning commercial wheels.
